name: Visa de Solvencia Económica Propia

requirements.blocker_text: Requires at least USD 300,000 in Panamanian real estate, a Certificate of Deposit, or a combination of both, plus an additional USD 2,000 per dependent.
requirements.fix_path: Fund and document the qualifying real estate and/or deposit.

evidence_required.document: Property deed and/or Certificate of Deposit

outcome.duration_length: 2 years provisional, then eligible to apply for permanent residence

sources.title: Kraemer & Kraemer -- Panama Economic Self-Solvency Visa: USD 300,000 (real estate and/or CD) + USD 2,000/dependent, 2-year provisional-to-permanent timeline
Servicio Nacional de Migración de Panamá -- Permisos Migratorios overview, confirming 'Economic solvency via fixed deposits or real estate' as a permanent-resident special-policy category

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of Panama's initial build.
